beforePause.dialog:
EYES ONLY // VESPER
×
BRING THEM HOME.

The Drowned Relay was built to preserve human memories. Last night, it began broadcasting them as a distress call.

BREACH THE STATION

Use the central yard and its side lanes. Concrete cover breaks a sentinel's line of sight.

RECOVER THREE CORES

Follow the cyan signal pylons to the waist-high memory receivers five metres in front. Approach a receiver and hold E for one second. Stay nearby while the memory is recovered. Each recovery escalates the defense response.

RETURN TO EXTRACTION

Bring all three memories to the green beacon where you entered. Follow either lit return aisle around the induction block. At the beacon, face back toward the yard and move between the split blast baffles while the uplink completes. Watch the open flanks.

Red means danger. Cyan means life. Soul Shift is your way through.

ACCEPT BRIEFING
↗
